items.title: Critical Citrix XenServer Vulnerability Could Let Hackers Take Over Virtualization Hosts Without Authentication
items.description: Citrix has disclosed a critical XenServer vulnerability that could let an unauthenticated attacker compromise virtualization hosts and supporting appliances. Tracked as CVE-2026-98432, the flaw requires access to the management network, an important limit when assessing which systems are exposed.
